## Recording Recipe

Generated by `scripts/record-agent-fixtures.sh --agent codex`. The harness uses a
**stable per-agent recorder home OUTSIDE the repo** at
`${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/rusty-brain/fixture-record/codex/` so persisted
trust survives across runs. The operator's real auth is COPIED in (read-only on
the real side, mode 0600), so the real agent home (`~/.codex` /
`~/.local/share/opencode`) is never mutated.

codex computes a per-hook `trusted_hash` that cannot be hand-written, so the operator pre-trusts the hooks ONCE via `--setup-trust codex` (interactive TUI); persisted `[hooks.state]` trust then lets recording run with NO `--dangerously-bypass-hook-trust` flag.

Record command: `CODEX_HOME=<rec> codex exec --json -C <rec proj> -s workspace-write --skip-git-repo-check -c approval_policy="never" "<prompt>"`. One multi-turn headless session (one Bash + one file write)
is captured to `result.jsonl`, then sanitized.

## Sanitization

| What | Recorded value | Committed value |
|---|---|---|
| Home dir (recorder + real) | `/Users/<real>` | `/Users/user` |
| Secrets (bearer/sk-/AKIA/key=value/`"key":"value"`/PEM) | real | `<redacted>` |

The recorder home holds the copied auth and session history; it lives outside
the repo and is never committed. Only sanitized per-event payloads + the
sanitized `result.jsonl` are written under `crates/rb-hooks/tests/fixtures/codex/`.
